lore_facts: There is an imperial couple important enough that access to them is tightly restricted.
Strangers are apparently not supposed to receive an audience with the imperial couple.
The setting includes highly formal, monumental imperial architecture.
The palace or imperial interior contains a luminous circular passage or device that people can walk through.
plot_events: A red-armored guard rejects the idea that strangers could be granted an audience with the imperial couple.
The guards' disbelief escalates into alarm as they notice an unexpected intruder or development.
A white-suited man appears walking through an area littered with defeated red-armored guards.
The white-suited man proceeds up a staircase toward a large formal door inside the palace complex.
He enters a larger ceremonial hall where bystanders watch him approach a glowing circular structure or doorway.
The man passes through the glowing circular threshold and continues onward.

visual_summary: In a bright, ornate palace-like interior, a red-armored guard reacts in shock while another face looks on in close-up. A white-suited man advances through a room strewn with fallen red-armored bodies, heads toward a monumental stair and ceremonial doorway, passes onlookers in a grand hall, and steps through a glowing circular portal or threshold.
